question: The price of an item is reduced by 20%. As a result, customers can get 2 kg more of it for ₹360. Find the original price (in ₹) per kg of the item.
solution:
**Given:**

The price of an item is reduced by 20%. As a result, customers can get 2 kg more of it for ₹360

**Calculation:**

20% = 1/5

Let the actual price be 5x

So, after reduction it will be 4x

According to the question,

(360/4x) - (360/5x) = 2

⇒ (90/x) - (72/x) = 2

⇒ [(90 - 72)/x] = 2

⇒ 18 = 2x

⇒ x = 9

So, actual price = 5 × 9 = 45

**∴ The original price (in ₹) per kg of the item is 45.**
